fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/brief-person-note.test.ts, describe 'l3-small, run L3: the brief carries what the person typed, never a button's label (L3-github-4)'. All 4 cases failed at the base: Redo with no note; Edit of only the budget; a typed note exactly once, after a restart, and not again after its work finished; Stop then Resume with no note. They run on the composed daemon through POST /tasks/:id/action and PUT /tasks/:id.
fixed.how: Root cause: personNoteOn (session/task-context.ts) quoted the newest change-log row's words_used. For a change made in the app, words_used is the button's label when no note was typed (server.ts fills in `Edit <title>`, ACTION_WORDS, `move to <status>`, 'Change what it waits for'). I deleted personNoteOn and its section, as the verifier preferred. A typed note reaches the brief once, as the queued 'About "<title>": …' note (queueNote, then notesForTask and renderQueueNotes), and is used up by work that finished (design §4.7). executor-brief.test.ts's retry case now passes the typed note as a queued note and asserts that no label is quoted. Docs: runtime.md (what else a task's brief carries) and the user guide.

fixed.how: Root cause: the id in the subject was the lookup key for loop/critic.ts (the diff of kept work) and loop/project-checks.ts scriptsBefore. When the snapshot commit is made, the executor sets refs of Forerunner's own: snapshotRef (refs/forerunner/before/<task>, the last snapshot) and firstSnapshotRef (refs/forerunner/first/<task>). Both lookups read the refs and still read an earlier version's '(task <id>)' commits. builtOnBy accepts both subjects. not_done.problem: L3-github-6, second half: the intake docs PR's branch name still carries the project's UUID (fr/intake-<project id>-docs).
not_done.why: The branch name is how a project's docs PR is found. isProjectDocsPr (loop/docs.ts) matches /^fr\/intake-(.+)-docs$/ against safeSegment(project.id), and intake.ts reuses an open PR by that head. intake.test.ts also requires that 'two projects of one minute never share it'. A name-based branch would need a hidden PR-body mark for ownership, plus a migration that keeps finding the open PRs earlier versions opened. The area's cut line allows leaving this out. Suggested follow-up: branch 'fr/intake-docs-<slug of the project name>' with docsPrMarker(project) in the body, isProjectDocsPr reading the mark first and the old pattern second.

Sibling of L3-github-8, not changed: loop/take-out.ts makes a quoted task title a possessive (`"Write the docs"'s work is not in main`, `"X"'s project has no repository`). That is the take-out words, outside this area. Agent possessives ("${agentName}'s memory" in commands/memory.ts and model-settings.ts) were left as they are: a singular name ending in s takes 's in English.

POST /tasks/:id/transition and /dependencies with a `reason` (API clients and the e2e worlds only; the UI sends `note`): the reason no longer reaches any brief. It used to reach it only through words_used, which is the bug fixed here. If an API reason should reach the brief, the route should send it as `note`.

queueNote (commands/task.ts) records author_human = ctx.humanId even when an agent is the actor. With personNoteOn gone, a queued note is the only channel into the brief. Once C4/C6 let the agent pass `note` on its own command turns, that note would be rendered under 'Left for this session by the human'. Mark agent notes (author_agent, or a kind) before then.
notes_for_other_areas: C2 d1109-oversize-pause (task-context.ts): I removed personNoteOn (base lines ~127-145), its call and section in taskContextBlock (base ~266-268), and reworded the header comment. whereTheLastRunStopped and its call are untouched. The only change near your hunk is that the comment replaced the three removed lines just before the sessionNote section.

C4/C6 d1109-selftasks-run/-chat: the brief no longer reads the change log at all, so an agent-actor command turn's words_used (recorded with human_id = the person) can never reach a brief as the person's note. The person's typed note reaches the brief only as the queued note: queueNote → notesForTask → renderQueueNotes under 'Left for this session by the human', used up by finished work. If agent turns may pass `note`, mark those queue rows as the agent's (see new_problems).

CR-2 d1109-chat-recall: @forerunner/commands (commands/task.ts, re-exported from the package index) now exports sameTitleTags(tasks) → {task, tag, says}[] (the one kind the refusal names; unchanged words), sameTitlePickers(tasks) → {task, says: RegExp[]}[] (every kind that tells a task apart), pickSameTitled(tasks, word) → TaskRow | undefined, and pickWord(rest). To list same-titled tasks as W15-37 words them, use sameTitleTags(group).map(t => t.tag). To resolve a word, use pickSameTitled(group, pickWord(textAfterTitle)).

Words changed that later areas may assert: the session-end status note is now `${endedStatusText(status, stopReason, {needYou, paused})}. Spent CHF x.` (runner.ts, at the writeSessionStatus call; the endedNote variable). @forerunner/memory StatusUpdate has a new optional startedAt (ProjectDocs.writeSessionStatus fills it) and a heading of '### Session started <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM> UTC'.

runner.ts TaskStep's tool kind has a new optional deniedCode (from tool_denied.code), and stepLine words denied steps through refusedLine. l3-money-engine owns the replan and review-only plan line in runner.ts; I touched only stepLine/refusedLine, the TaskStep type, the stop-words import and the status note line.

@forerunner/capabilities exports snapshotRef(taskId), firstSnapshotRef(taskId) and snapshotSubject(task). The 'Workspace before' subject has no '(task <id>)'; loop/critic.ts and loop/project-checks.ts read the refs first, then the old message. Set-aside and failed-run commit messages have no id either.
